sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently leading the division with 22 points from 10 games and riding an impressive run of five wins in their last six matches, host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00. Alsager arrive in poor form, occupying the bottom two with just four points and coming off five consecutive defeats before a recent win. This should be a straightforward outing for the league leaders.
divisionWide: Second-place Stafford Town face a stern test against Dawley Town at home, with Stafford just two points behind Sandbach and looking to maintain pressure after a recent draw. The chasing pack remains tightly bunched: AFC Bridgnorth (third, 19 points) travel to Eccleshall (fifth, 18 points) in a fixture between two of the league's strongest sides, while Wolverhampton Casuals host Wednesfield Community in a local derby between 4th and 9th. Bilston Town, 6th with recent strong form (five wins in their last six), welcome struggling Foley Meir to test their momentum. Mid-table clashes include Shawbury United (10th, winless in five) against in-form Barnton (7th, recent win), and Market Drayton Town hosting New Mills in a battle of sides with patchy recent records. The bottom of the table sees winless Widnes Town visit struggling Brereton Social (both on poor runs), while Crewe host Allscott Heath in another fixture involving teams fighting relegation form. Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to Telford Town in a bottom-half encounter between two of the division's weakest sides.
